title: rule-findings-stats benchmark (#285) reads the retired rule-evidence ledger — where does it read post-cutover?
context: Phase C retires recordRuleFindings (the rule-evidence project-ledger writer) and deletes rule-ledger.ts. But scripts/rule-findings-stats.mjs + scripts/lib/findings-stats.mjs (issue #285, weekly deterministic-findings benchmark) read that ledger via readProjectEvents(RULE_EVIDENCE_DOC_TYPE) from dist, and tests/e2e/benchmark-scripts.e2e.test.ts seeds it via recordRuleFindings. Phase B re-pointed the dashboard/SIEM to the bundle but NOT this benchmark. Retiring the writer leaves the benchmark permanently 'no data'. Findings now live in the per-feature bundle rule-run.jsonl (same {kind:findings,counts.deterministic,ts} shape appendRuleRun writes on fresh runs). No feature-evidence/projections tsup entry exists in dist today.

options.label: Re-point the benchmark to the bundle: glob .paqad/ledger/feature-evidence/*/rule-run.jsonl in the .mjs (self-contained at the mjs boundary, like the mjs resolveRagHome), seed the e2e test with bundle rule-run rows. Benchmark stays honest post-cutover.
Add a feature-evidence/projections tsup entry and re-point the benchmark to import readAllFeatureRuleRuns from dist (reuses the canonical reader, adds a build entry + dist dependency).

Keep recordRuleFindings writing the rule-evidence project ledger solely to feed this benchmark; retire only recordRuleDrift + the drift half — narrower cutover, but leaves a live old-home write the task asked to retire.

rationale: Findings live in the per-feature bundle rule-run.jsonl post-cutover; re-point the .mjs benchmark to glob the bundle dirs (self-contained at the mjs/TS boundary) rather than keep a live old-home write or add a build entry.
